headline: Local interior designer proposes replacing Parliament’s 'cold' carpets with 40,000 IKEA beanbags to restore intimacy
body:
"If you want people to actually get along, you have to force them into a semi-reclined, slightly awkward physical position where they can't help but make eye contact with the person snacking on a samosa next to them," says Rahul Verma, a local freelance interior decorator.

"The current setup is too formal; I think if we just threw a few mood lamps and a communal lava lamp in the center of the Lok Sabha, the debates would shift from policy to just deciding which Netflix series to binge next," suggests Anita Kulkarni, a third-year political science student.

"My tea stall gets more honest feedback in five minutes than a parliamentary committee gets in a year, and it’s mostly because I don’t have high ceilings and echoes to hide behind," claims Rajesh Gupta, a local chai stall owner.

"I tried working in a space like that once, and I felt so professional I accidentally started filing tax returns for my cat; a bit of clutter and a few beanbags would definitely make the whole place feel less like a library and more like a Sunday afternoon," adds commuter Sanjay Mehta.
caption: From beanbags to lava lamps: The interior design fix to cure the 'soul' deficit in our high-ceilinged capital. Does decor dictate democracy? (satire) #Parliament #DelhiDiaries #InteriorDesign #Democracy #TafriTimes
igHook: Would a few beanbags actually make our leaders get along better?
